_avail.notes: [AVAIL] powered by the host device / bus — no own power input

ports.label: Relay 1
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24V, 1A) on a shared 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw.

ports.label: Relay 2
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24V, 1A) on a shared 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw.

ports.label: Digital Input
ports.notes: Configurable digital input (0-24 VDC, +5V pullup) on a 2-pole 3.5mm captive screw.

ports.label: RS-232 Port 1
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 (Port 1) on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw.

ports.label: RS-232 Port 2
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 (Port 2) on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw.

ports.label: IR Out
ports.notes: Programmable TTL-level (0-5V) IR output (carrier and non-carrier, up to 300 kHz) on a 2-pole 3.5mm captive screw.

ports.label: USB Micro-B (Host)
ports.notes: Male USB Micro-B for connecting to a host TouchLink Pro / TLC Pro panel's USB Micro-B port. Bus-powered (no separate DC power input).; powered by host
